about: KDLM is a personal injury firm with a single office in Manhattan.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

G1.evidence: 8 of 10 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 2 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way
G1.source: NYS Attorney Registrations (data.ny.gov eqw2-r5nb), published by the NYS Unified Court System

G2.evidence: None of the 8 named attorneys carries a disciplinary status on the public register: no disbarment, suspension or disciplinary resignation. Those statuses persist, so the check reaches back years, but it would not show a censure or a suspension since lifted.
G2.source: NYS Attorney Registrations (data.ny.gov eqw2-r5nb), published by the NYS Unified Court System. Current status, which is what this register carries

G3.evidence: No matching entity found in the active corporations register. New York does not require a general partnership to file with the Department of State, so this is not evidence against the firm, only a check we could not complete from this source
G3.source: Active Corporations register (data.ny.gov n9v6-gdp6), published by the New York State Department of State, partial

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 10 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 33 public client reviews and 11 years since the entity was formed in 2015
G6.source: Google Places API and Active Corporations register (data.ny.gov n9v6-gdp6), published by the New York State Department of State

subs.label: Accountability
